name: lowpoly-green-hill-render
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a LOW-POLY 3D render in the style of a late-1990s / early PlayStation-era game — faceted angular geometry, flat-shaded polygons, coarse warped textures, hard vertex lighting.
· RENDER ARTIFACTS: blurry smeared faces with no fine detail, soft melted edges, low internal resolution, texture stretching, a naive amateur-CGI look.
· GROUND: a simple stylised landscape — a blocky GREEN polygon hill meeting a hazy pale-blue sky, a single dark angular mountain silhouette in the distance.
· LIGHT: flat soft ambient daylight, gentle gradient sky, minimal shadows, low contrast.
· PALETTE: deep grass GREEN ground, muted powder-BLUE and white sky, earthy browns, dull primary accents on clothing.
· SIGNATURE: a subtle painterly CANVAS or paper texture laid over the whole render, softening it like a painting of a videogame still.
· MOOD: eerie, lonely, uncanny, quiet dream-logic nostalgia.
· GRAIN: soft airbrushed blur throughout plus fine canvas-weave texture, faded matte tones.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
